title: Implement /blog/[slug] page with Article schema and breadcrumb navigation
description: Create Next.js dynamic route for individual blog posts rendering full content with Article and BreadcrumbList JSON-LD schemas to improve SEO visibility in Google Search and blog post discovery.
acceptanceCriteria: /blog/[slug]/page.tsx displays blog post title, author, publish date, featured image, and full content from static blog data structure
Article schema includes author, datePublished, dateModified, image, wordCount, and articleBody in <script type="application/ld+json">
BreadcrumbList schema renders breadcrumb path (Home > Blog > Post Title) with itemListElement array
technicalNotes: File to create: site/src/app/blog/[slug]/page.tsx - implement generateStaticParams and generateMetadata exports
File to create: site/src/lib/schemas/article.ts - export generateArticleSchema(post: BlogPost, baseUrl: string)
File to create: site/src/lib/schemas/breadcrumb.ts - export generateBreadcrumbSchema(postTitle: string, slug: string)
Test command: npm run build && curl http://localhost:3000/blog/johor-backpacker-guide | grep -c 'application/ld+json' (should output 2 or more)

title: Build /blog index page with real-time category and tag filtering
description: Create /blog listing page with client-side filtering UI for categories and tags, plus schema.org CollectionPage markup to improve blog discoverability in Google search results.
acceptanceCriteria: /blog/page.tsx displays grid of all blog posts with title, excerpt, date, category badge, and read-time estimate with no page reload
Category and tag filter chips toggle post visibility via React state (use 'use client' component), with active filter count badge
CollectionPage JSON-LD schema includes numberOfItems count, hasPart array of article references, and mainEntity object with blog URL
technicalNotes: File to create: site/src/app/blog/page.tsx - 'use client' component with useState for active filters, map over filtered posts
File to create: site/src/components/BlogPostGrid.tsx - grid component rendering BlogPostCard items with author, date, and tags
File to create: site/src/lib/schemas/collection.ts - export generateCollectionPageSchema(posts: BlogPost[], baseUrl: string)
Test command: npm run dev && curl http://localhost:3000/blog | grep -o 'CollectionPage' | head -1

title: Create JB News & Updates widget synced to curated RSS feeds on homepage
description: Build an async Server Component fetching latest news from 3+ curated JB/Singapore RSS sources and displaying on homepage hero, with NewsArticle schema markup for improved news visibility.
acceptanceCriteria: JbNewsWidget async component fetches RSS feeds from 3+ sources with 10-second timeout and displays latest 3 news items as clickable cards
Each news card shows headline, source name/logo, publication date, and link to source article without opening new tab on small screens
NewsArticle schema for each item includes headline, description, datePublished, image, author, and articleBody fields in page JSON-LD
technicalNotes: File to create: site/src/components/JbNewsWidget.tsx - async Server Component with error boundary, renders up to 3 feed items
File to create: site/src/lib/rss/parser.ts - export parseRssFeed(url: string, timeout: number): Promise<NewsItem[]>
File to create: site/src/lib/rss/sources.ts - export RSS_SOURCES array with {name, url, category} objects for JB/Singapore feeds
Test command: npm run dev && curl -s http://localhost:3000 | grep -o 'JbNewsWidget\|NewsArticle' | head -5

title: Implement /api/feed route for RSS/Atom feed with blog posts and news
description: Create API route generating valid RSS 2.0 feed with all blog posts and curated news items, plus auto-discovery link tag in layout head for feed reader compatibility.
acceptanceCriteria: GET /api/feed returns valid RSS 2.0 XML with Content-Type: application/rss+xml, includes 10+ blog post items with title, link, pubDate (RFC 2822), guid, and description
Each RSS item links to full blog post at /blog/[slug] with proper URL encoding and includes author email and category tags
Auto-discovery <link rel="alternate" type="application/rss+xml" href="/api/feed" title="Blog"> tag present in site/src/app/layout.tsx <head>
technicalNotes: File to create: site/src/app/api/feed/route.ts - export async function GET() returning RSS XML response with proper headers
File to create: site/src/lib/feed/generator.ts - export generateRssFeed(posts: BlogPost[], baseUrl: string): string
File to modify: site/src/app/layout.tsx - add Feed auto-discovery link in <Head> component or metadata export
Test command: npm run dev && curl -s http://localhost:3000/api/feed | head -20 && npm run build && cat .next/server/app/api/feed/route.js | grep -c 'rss+xml'

title: Update sitemap.ts to include blog post URLs with publication metadata
description: Extend sitemap.ts to dynamically generate <url> entries for all blog posts with lastModified dates, proper changefreq, and priority scores for SEO indexing across search engines.
acceptanceCriteria: sitemap.ts iterates over getAllBlogPosts() and appends <url> entries with loc path (/blog/[slug]), lastmod (ISO 8601 format), changefreq="weekly", priority=0.8
Blog post lastmod sourced from post.dateModified frontmatter field, fallback to file mtime if missing
Generated sitemap XML validates against sitemap protocol schema v0.9 and includes 10+ blog post URLs
technicalNotes: File to modify: site/src/app/sitemap.ts - add blog post loop after static routes: for (const post of getAllBlogPosts()) { routes.push({url: `/blog/${post.slug}`, lastModified: post.dateModified, ...}) }
File to verify: site/src/lib/blog/posts.ts - ensure getAllBlogPosts() export returns BlogPost[] with slug and dateModified fields
Test command: npm run build && cat .next/static/sitemap.xml | grep -c '/blog/' (count should match total blog posts), grep '<priority>0.8</priority>' to verify priority
